title: Head of Operations
description: Job DescriptionRole: Head of Operations, MACS India – Marketing & Creative ServicesLocation:  Mumbai, India Grade: D1/D2 Based in Mumbai, India, the Head of Operations, MACS will serve as a pivotal role to drive operations for Capgemini Business Services Marketing Operations unit and full stack global marketing services agency, MACS (Marketing & Creative Services). The role is a key hire at an opportune time when MACS is undergoing an organization- wide transformation in building new capability, processes, and talent towards a new vision.  MACS is a large global operation of more than 300 marcomm professionals in India and Poland, providing a multitude of services across streams such as marketing, communications, digital, analytics, martech and creative services to the Marketing & Communications functions of Capgemini. As MACS looks for growth and expansion in its operations, the Head Operations, in India, will be responsible to oversee operational excellence, revenue and budget management, change management and drive various transformation initiatives spanning a large team of 270 people in MACS India.  Job RoleRoleAs the Head of Operations - MACS, you would have a broad view of all aspects of the MACS delivery operations across streams, and geographies globally, operating out of India. You would be responsible to lead operations of a large marcomm services unit to build in efficiency in delivery operations, key priorities, introduce new processes in hiring/talent demand forecasting, introduce work-flow automation, project feedback, employee engagement attrition, management reporting on an on-going basis.  As a lead for MACS Operations, you will be a partner to Global MACS lead and work alongside MACS IN delivery leader, and service delivery leads from across streams on ensuring efficient, timely, delivery operations and governance.  You will be responsible for managing escalation on all operations and be a single point of contact for all internal operations in MACS India.You will also be responsible for setting the agenda for operations transformation in MACS – interfacing with delivery teams, finance teams, audit and compliance, governance, employee engagement activities. Job Responsibilities Manage and bring in efficient operational change through new processes, dashboards and team communication Support the MACS Global Lead on managing all operations. Bring in an overview of all key delivery projects across streams and progress on timely delivery on the same. You’ll be responsible for delivery Operations reporting (Management Reviews, Reporting, Invoicing, SLA/KPI tracking etc.). Financial management, audits You will be managing along with the MACS Global Lead, all inputs required for MACS financial overview and targets (budget management, revenue management, competitiveness, utilization metrics) for resources in MACS India. You will be responsible for financial tracking and reporting with the finance team. You will also manage various management reporting requirements, like reviews, audits etc.Manage talent forecast, recruitment, HR liaison You will be responsible for driving and optimizing the recruitment process and dashboards and you will work with the MACS Leads (Design, Digital & Content, Comms, Marketing, ABM & Pursuits) to identify recruitment needs and be with locate the single point of contact with HR and the practice team in the recruitment process for all key hires. You will also manage the resource pipeline running efficiently. Work on a process for performance and rewards management. Drive Process improvement | SLA tracking | Tools procurement You will be reporting to MACS Global Lead in driving key initiatives of the MACS transformation that bring in better productivity, and efficiency in delivery operations. responsible in driving key initiatives to improve MACS processes including project management, automation adoption, talent onboarding, and people management that are a part of the MACS transformation.ResponsibilitiesStakeholder escalation management You will support MACS IN delivery Lead in ensuring appropriate, proactive communication with key stakeholders including overviewing arrangement of meetings and visits and ensuring timely delivery of periodically requested information. You will be leading all management reviews on MACS with Bsv leadership.Employee experience management Build and implement an outstanding onboarding and employee experience. With 200+ people, we need a consistent and reassuring onboarding experience that provides new joiners with an onboarding experience that makes them feel comfortable and inspires them to be the best at their job that they can be. Work on building new team culture, rituals, by organizing workshops, learning sessions, events and quick ‘pick me ups’, and to flag any issues that you feel might be affecting team morale Coordinate the team management agenda and activities. You’ll be part of the team’s senior management and will be responsible for creating and driving the agenda and liaising with the local organization on matters such as facilities (e.g., space allowance).Business community and risk management: Be responsible for all Bsv actions on managing crisis, risk, and business continuity processes.Be responsible for knowledge management and internal comms. As our team grows, it’s become harder to keep people up to date with developments such as new joiners, impact of global business results on our team, key projects, new processes, deadlines, etc. Your role will be to ensure that the team is informed of all relevant developments, and that they’re clear and well understood within the team.MACS Onboarding & new processes - help craft, document and implement processes.
